original.discovery_notes: A leaf routine called from at least 0x88002bb4, 0x88007cfc, and 0x88008010. copy_record_fields is provisional until a caller identifies the record's game-level meaning.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_8800700c.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 3 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Three controlled calls were executed by the original R4600 instructions in MAME. The native test reproduces each output, confirms the 16-byte source is unchanged, and compares the full 1 MiB mapped test RAM byte-for-byte to prove that no unexpected location was modified.
